Elena —

Congrats on getting the SOW across the line. I put together a working MAP and a condensed readiness runbook (attached) — high level below, then next steps. Please review and flag any timing constraints.

Working MAP highlights (draft):
- Kickoff & alignment call: Tue 2026-09-01 10:00 PDT / 17:00 UTC (30m) — confirm owners and SLAs
- Pre-cutover dry run: Thu 2026-09-03 02:00 PDT / 09:00 UTC (lift-and-test with limited traffic)
- Canary phase (controlled traffic shift):
  * Day 0 (2026-09-06): 5% traffic for 6 hours, acceptance checks (error rate, latency, functional eval)
  * Day 1–2: 25% traffic, broaden eval set; automated rollbacks if thresholds breached
  * Day 3–5: 75% -> 100% based on success criteria
- Migration window: 2026-09-06 — 2026-09-10 (full cutover target 2026-09-08 evening UTC)
- Training sprint (two sessions):
  * Admin & integrators — Wed 2026-09-02 11:00 PDT (60m)
  * Frontline ops — Fri 2026-09-04 09:00 PDT (60m)
- Evaluation plan: per-token regression checks, prompt-set A/B on canary cohorts, weekly quality review during first 30 days
- Contingency: staged rollback to previous model variant + traffic throttling; dedicated on-call from Redwood infra team for first 72 hours

Attachments included: staged-cutover-checklist.xlsx (master runbook) — contains step-by-step play actions, acceptance thresholds, and owner matrix.

Next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff time and training attendees (list + roles)
2) Confirm dry-run window or propose alternate
3) Approve MAP as-is or suggest edits by EOD Mon 2026-08-31

I'll loop in our CS lead (Marissa) and the infra ops lead (Jonas) in a follow-up once we have your preferred times.

Best,

Thanks Hannah — good first pass. Two quick technical notes from infra before Elena signs off on the final MAP:

1) Canary acceptance gates (recommended):
   - Error rate threshold: >0.5% increase over baseline -> pause
   - 95th pct latency delta: >200ms increase -> pause and investigate
   - Functional eval: run 50 pre-defined prompts across canary cohort; require >=98% match on critical intents

2) Canary cadence suggestion: keep Day 0 longer for the initial 5% (8 hours) to capture evening traffic patterns for Luminary (their peak hours start ~UT C 20:00). If that works for the team, adjust Day 0 to 8 hours.

3) Rollback play: automated traffic re-route + freeze deploys; we should pre-authorize a rollback window and the person(s) who can execute it (ops lead + Luminary on-call).

Marissa — can you confirm availability for the two proposed training sessions and the dry-run? Also please prep a short checklist for the dry-run (user journeys we should validate).

-Jonas
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
